name: Puya Semiconductor (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Puya Semiconductor (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, design, and sale of non-volatile memory chips and memory-based derivative chips in China and internationally. Its products include SPI NOR and automotive Flash; standard and automotive Eeprom; MCU; and analog, including VCM driver, as well as known good die services.
